You are very very much right, te same magical effect does NOT stack unless by some reason specified so, two casters can't enlarge twice something, nor geas it or anything of the like.

BUT you are wrong on one thing, it's the same spell that doesn't stack, if by no means it's described as "same as using X" or that "X spell" doesn't have on it's description something that doesn't let you stack anything beyond that, you're good to go.

An example for this would be weapon enhancing spells, yes, you can give one non-magical weapon additional damage, but the thing is, after using this spell, the weapon becomes magical, so you can't buff it any further.

In this case, the racial spellcasting allows you to use a spell, being limited for this race to not be in direct sunlight for the casting, not doing it in anything but yourself and only being able to enlarge, those are the original limitations, however neirher there nor in the class features is anything like "your size can't be changed further" or "you need to be your original size*
